lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Bravo! Super fuel! Candy bar plus soda! Zoom zoom forever!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [excited][beeping] Bravo! Super fuel! [proud] Candy bar plus soda! [giggles] Zoom zoom forever!
lines.spoken_text: Bravo! Super fuel! Candy bar plus soda! Zoom zoom forever!

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Candy can be a treat. Treats are sometimes food. Everyday food is the food you eat most days. Let's check the chalkboard.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [amused][warm] Candy can be a treat. [clear] Treats are sometimes food. [gentle] Everyday food is the food you eat most days. [curious] Let's check the chalkboard.
lines.spoken_text: Candy can be a treat. Treats are sometimes food. Everyday food is the food you eat most days. Let's check the chalkboard.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Everyday food looks like this. An apple. A carrot. A banana. Broccoli. Eggs. Bread. They give energy to play, food to grow, and tiny helpers that keep you well.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [teacher] Everyday food looks like this. [pause] An apple. A carrot. A banana. Broccoli. Eggs. Bread. [warm] They give energy to play, food to grow, and tiny helpers that keep you well.
lines.spoken_text: Everyday food looks like this. An apple. A carrot. A banana. Broccoli. Eggs. Bread. They give energy to play, food to grow, and tiny helpers that keep you well.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Bite an apple. It is sweet from the tree. The chewy bits help your tummy. Like a tiny broom, sweeping food along. That is why fruit is not the same as candy.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [clear] Bite an apple. It is sweet from the tree. [pause] The chewy bits help your tummy. [playful] Like a tiny broom, sweeping food along. [happy] That is why fruit is not the same as candy.
lines.spoken_text: Bite an apple. It is sweet from the tree. The chewy bits help your tummy. Like a tiny broom, sweeping food along. That is why fruit is not the same as candy.

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.elevenlabs_text: [delighted] Tummy broom! [laughs] Sweep sweep apple! [beeps happily]

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Now candy. It is packed with sugar. Sugar is a FAST zap. You feel zoomy... then crash. Tired. Grumpy. The zoom runs out.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [firm but kind] Now candy. It is packed with sugar. [pause] Sugar is a FAST zap. [excited] You feel zoomy... [soft] then crash. Tired. Grumpy. [clear] The zoom runs out.
lines.spoken_text: Now candy. It is packed with sugar. Sugar is a FAST zap. You feel zoomy... then crash. Tired. Grumpy. The zoom runs out.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Sugar also sticks on teeth. Tiny germs eat that sugar. Then they make holes. So sweets are sometimes food. Not everyday food.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [clear] Sugar also sticks on teeth. [pause] Tiny germs eat that sugar. Then they make holes. [gentle] So sweets are sometimes food. Not everyday food.
lines.spoken_text: Sugar also sticks on teeth. Tiny germs eat that sugar. Then they make holes. So sweets are sometimes food. Not everyday food.

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Holes in Bravo teeth? Do not want a Swiss-cheese smile!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [horrified comedy][gasps] Holes in Bravo teeth? [worried] Do not want a Swiss-cheese smile!
lines.spoken_text: Holes in Bravo teeth? Do not want a Swiss-cheese smile!

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Soda is sneakier. It looks like a drink. It is water plus a sugar storm plus bubbles. Your body asked for water. Water is the real drink. Milk too. Soda is a sometimes sip.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [nodding] Soda is sneakier. [pause] It looks like a drink. [clear] It is water plus a sugar storm plus bubbles. [warm] Your body asked for water. [firm] Water is the real drink. Milk too. [gentle] Soda is a sometimes sip.
lines.spoken_text: Soda is sneakier. It looks like a drink. It is water plus a sugar storm plus bubbles. Your body asked for water. Water is the real drink. Milk too. Soda is a sometimes sip.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Some snacks are changed in a factory. Chips. Packaged sweets. Extra sugar, extra salt, extra oil. They last on a shelf and shout at your tongue. Tummy fills up... helpers never arrive. Sometimes food. Not everyday food.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [teacher] Some snacks are changed in a factory. [pause] Chips. Packaged sweets. Extra sugar, extra salt, extra oil. [clear] They last on a shelf and shout at your tongue. [gentle] Tummy fills up... helpers never arrive. [firm] Sometimes food. Not everyday food.
lines.spoken_text: Some snacks are changed in a factory. Chips. Packaged sweets. Extra sugar, extra salt, extra oil. They last on a shelf and shout at your tongue. Tummy fills up... helpers never arrive. Sometimes food. Not everyday food.

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Sometimes was my every day. Candy goes in the sometimes box.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [caught][guilty] Sometimes... was my every day. [sighs] Candy goes in the sometimes box. [small beep]
lines.spoken_text: Sometimes... was my every day. Candy goes in the sometimes box.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: One more job. Wash fruits and veggies BEFORE you eat them. Dirt, dust, and tiny germs ride on the skin. People touch them at the store. Rub under clean water. No soap. Then they are ready.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [bright] One more job. [pause] Wash fruits and veggies BEFORE you eat them. [clear] Dirt, dust, and tiny germs ride on the skin. People touch them at the store. [warm] Rub under clean water. No soap. Then they are ready.
lines.spoken_text: One more job. Wash fruits and veggies BEFORE you eat them. Dirt, dust, and tiny germs ride on the skin. People touch them at the store. Rub under clean water. No soap. Then they are ready.

lines.speaker: PIPI
lines.text: Pipi licks apples. Licking is not washing. Water first.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [proud] Pipi licks apples. [pause][accepting] Licking is not washing. [beeps softly] Water first.
lines.spoken_text: Pipi licks apples. Licking is not washing. Water first.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Rainbow plate. Red apple helps your tummy. Orange carrot helps you see. Yellow banana gives energy that lasts. Green broccoli helps you stay well. Eggs help you grow. Bread helps you run and play.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [excited] Rainbow plate. [warm] Red apple helps your tummy. Orange carrot helps you see. Yellow banana gives energy that lasts. Green broccoli helps you stay well. Eggs help you grow. Bread helps you run and play.
lines.spoken_text: Rainbow plate. Red apple helps your tummy. Orange carrot helps you see. Yellow banana gives energy that lasts. Green broccoli helps you stay well. Eggs help you grow. Bread helps you run and play.

lines.speaker: BRAVO
lines.text: Tonight mission: wash a fruit. Eat it. Drink water. Save candy for sometimes. Widgeteers Explains, mystery solved.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [sincere] Tonight mission: [pause] wash a fruit. Eat it. Drink water. Save candy for sometimes. [proud][smiles] Widgeteers Explains... mystery solved.
lines.spoken_text: Tonight mission: wash a fruit. Eat it. Drink water. Save candy for sometimes. Widgeteers Explains... mystery solved.
